messages:
Ava: quick heads-up — planning to create release/1.14 tomorrow 18:00 UTC. Please confirm branch owner and any immediate cherrypicks you need before cutoff. 

Chris: I can create the branch and push it. who wants ownership of backports?

Jorge: tagging for backend regressions — I have two fixes that should be backported. i'll open cherrypick PRs today.

Priya: docs needs a minor version bump in docs/site/config and CHANGELOG entry. can somebody remind me which file we prefer for the release note?

Ava: CHANGELOG.md under /docs is canonical. add a short bullet and link to the PR. Version bump in package.json / helm charts should be a separate PR aimed at the release branch.

Jorge: quick Q on process — after branch creation do we target release/1.14 for the backport PRs or open them against main and request backport?

Chris: target release/1.14 directly. use the label backport/1.14 and include `cherry-pick: yes` in the PR body. we'll run the usual backport checks.

Sandra: cutoff reminder: any non-critical changes must land before 17:00 UTC tomorrow. critical fixes only after that with ENG-APPROVE from a lead + me on call.

Ava: exact branching commands for owners (paste in case folks need it):
```
# create branch locally
git checkout -b release/1.14 main
# push to origin
git push origin release/1.14
# cherry-pick example
git checkout release/1.14
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
git push origin release/1.14
```

Priya: noted. i'll open the docs PR against release/1.14 and add the changelog bullet.

Jorge: opening two backport PRs now. will add backport/1.14 label and link to the original fixes.

Chris: i'll create the branch at 18:00 UTC unless someone needs an earlier window. I'll post the branch link when done. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: build/branch-creation job queued for release/1.14 by Chris at 1767003000 (simulated).

Ava: FYI: if any PR touches model-serving runtime or config schema, add a note in the PR body about compatibility (seq_len, kv cache). we may pin a special test job.

Sandra: oncall will validate release smoke between 18:15-18:30 UTC. please don't schedule heavy infra changes during that window.

Chris: branch created: https://git.example.com/redwood/repo/branches/release/1.14 (pushed). owners: Chris (branch), Jorge (backend backports), Priya (docs).

Jorge: PRs opened: #4123, #4124 — both labelled backport/1.14 and include commit links.

Priya: docs PR #4125 open and changelog entry added. pinging marketing for release blurb.

Ava: perfect. last ask — if you open a backport PR after cutoff, include the reason for late backport and add `ENG-APPROVE` tag; Sandra will triage oncall approvals.

Sandra: acknowledged. I'll watch the queue and respond to late requests.

Chris: minor reminder for release engineers — do not merge any feature PRs into release/1.14. only backports and bump PRs allowed.

Ava: thanks all. i'll follow up with the release checklist and a short reminder 1 hour before cutoff. :rocket:
